findings.description: The RDS instance sets storage_encrypted = false, so database storage and snapshots are stored unencrypted with no KMS customer-managed key.
publicly_accessible = true assigns the RDS instance a public IP and DNS, exposing the MySQL endpoint to the internet instead of keeping it in a private subnet.
The master username is the default 'admin', an easily guessed account name for credential stuffing/brute force against the internet-reachable database.

The master password is supplied via var.password, a plain Terraform variable which is recorded in plaintext in state and may be sourced from committed tfvars; no Secrets Manager/managed password is used.
No enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports (audit, error, general, slowquery) are configured, so database security events are not retained for audit.

The EC2 user_data embeds the database username and password (var.password) in the startup script; user data is readable via ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute and from the instance metadata service by any process on the host.
No metadata_options block enforcing http_tokens = "required", so IMDSv1 remains enabled and an SSRF in the PHP app could retrieve the instance role's credentials (which are wildcard-privileged).
No root_block_device/ebs encryption is specified, so the instance volumes holding the database credentials file may be stored unencrypted.
The instance is launched in a subnet and outputs a public DNS name, serving an unauthenticated HTTP-only application (no TLS) that transmits form data and renders DB contents in cleartext.

The instance role grants s3:*, ec2:*, and rds:* on Resource "*", which is effectively administrative over storage, compute, and databases and enables privilege escalation if the instance is compromised.
The database security group allows all outbound traffic on all protocols to 0.0.0.0/0, providing a data exfiltration and command-and-control path.
The MySQL parameter group does not set require_secure_transport = 1, so clients may connect to the publicly accessible database over unencrypted connections.
